Signals a strategic move into alpha-therapy supply chains, expanding IBA’s addressable market.
If executed, could create recurring isotope supply revenue and lock in customers.
Timeline sets investor expectations; revenue impact unlikely before 2028.
Second pilot site planned in U.S.
U.S. footprint would broaden access to key radiopharma clients.
Addresses current scarcity in alpha isotopes, a bottleneck for therapy rollouts.

This is an early-stage strategic expansion aligning IBA’s cyclotron tech with rising demand for targeted alpha therapies. For a larger catalyst, watch for funding, site build milestones, supply contracts, and regulatory/clinical adoption driving confirmed offtake.
